architecture_decision: Keep WOFOST81 as an explicit versioned composite path around the unchanged legacy crop owner. Reuse qualified SWAP5 weather/state seams where semantics agree, and add version-81 process layers only where donor semantics differ.
scientific_interpretation: The WOFOST81 assimilation path now has explicit version-81 table binding and consumes transaction-owned leaf-N state, while remaining unreachable from active runtime. The next scientific gap is WOFOST81 leaf ageing/N-stress rate composition: donor DRLV=max(DSLV,DALV), with DALV driven by NSLLV and early-LAI growth reduced by RFRGRL under N stress.
next_permitted_action: Implement a WOFOST81-only rate-correction layer that derives the donor N stress index, evaluates NSLLV, computes DALV, combines leaf death as max(DSLV,DALV), and applies donor early-LAI RFRGRL semantics. Keep it candidate-only and do not alter the legacy finalize/structural modules unless a separate preservation proof requires it.
